alice-springs-9.coordinates_source: Unchanged: Wikipedia point of the museum article; sits inside an OSM building cluster (ways 967007739-44, -23.7037 to -23.7041, 133.8767-133.8771). No OSM feature or Commons geotag names the Old Gaol; OSM Nominatim returned nothing.
alice-springs-9.note: Could not improve. Old Gaol article point (-23.7031,133.877) is 111 m north; the OSM building cluster supports the current point. Keep and flag for owner map check.

arnhem-land-3.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap: east end node of highway way 468097118 'East Woody Point' (road end at the beach); natural=beach way 49928797 runs along that shore (nearest beach vertex ~170 m). Moved ~200 m from the previous mid-road point.
arnhem-land-3.note: Road-end visitor/standing point; OSM has no named Galuru/Gaaluru feature. Island pin below is ~400 m away.

arnhem-land-4.coordinates_source: Centroid of OSM closed natural=coastline way 158247604 (the East Woody Island outline); Wikipedia 'East Woody Island' (-12.1614,136.7511) agrees within 50 m.
arnhem-land-4.note: Two independent sources within 100 m. About 400 m from the Galuru pin (>25 m).

nitmiluk-national-park-3.coordinates_source: OSM named ways 'Jatbula Trail' (18 ways chained, 52.1 km mapped, Biddlecombe-end -14.2549,132.4330 to Leliyn -14.1789,132.1931); halfway point of the chain is -14.11295,132.32781, shifted ~2.7 km toward the Nitmiluk end to allow ~10 km unmapped at the start (full route ~62 km). Snapped on an OSM way.
nitmiluk-national-park-3.note: The OSM route relations are split into 5 'section' relations, so the whole route was assembled from ways. Start segments near Nitmiluk Gorge (-14.31,132.42 to -14.25,132.43) are only partly mapped; true midpoint is within about 3 km along the trail.

elsey-national-park.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=camp_site node 1811179295 'Jalmurark Campground' (Elsey NP main camp and day-use area); tourism=information node 12993135674 is 30 m away.
elsey-national-park.note: Park visitor hub on Elsey Camp Drive, not the polygon centroid. Mataranka Falls viewpoint (Korowan) is 3.5 km east and Thermal Pools 6+ km west, so no pin clash.

keep-river-national-park.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=camp_site node 316581918 'Goorrandalng Camping Area' (Gurrandalng, the park's main camp and walk-start hub).
keep-river-national-park.note: Replaces the Jarnem Lookout point (a review-list walk). Park entrance info node is at -15.9702,129.0402 (not used). Jarnem Camping Area is -15.7626,129.0988.

giwining-nature-park.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=camp_site node 1811172150 'Djarrung Campground' (toilets node 12 m away; Flora River Walk starts here). Giwining is the Flora River Nature Park visitor area.
giwining-nature-park.note: No 'Lorrngorl' feature exists in OSM; Djarrung campground and Flora River Walk are the park's only visitor facilities there. About 700 m from the previous polygon point.

gosses-bluff.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=picnic_site node 311965802 on Namatjira Drive at the Tnorala viewing area (toilets 30 m away; viewpoint nodes 311965807 and 327775782 within 80 m).
gosses-bluff.note: Visitor viewing/day-use point replaces the crater-rim peak, ~3.5 km north.

ewaninga-conservation-reserve.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint node 2355812553 at the Ewaninga carvings (a second viewpoint 100 m SE, toilets and picnic site 200 m N).
ewaninga-conservation-reserve.note: Only ~25 m from the previous centroid pin; the reserve is tiny, so the gain is feature-level confirmation.

henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=information node 1574650659 at the Henbury Meteorite Craters camp/picnic/toilet hub (camp_site 316581627 and picnic_site 1574651042 within 50 m). Main crater group (craters 1-14) is 300-500 m east.
henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.note: Car park/visitor hub rather than the reserve centroid (~0.7 km SE).

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.coordinates_source: OSM hiking relation 13434620 'Uluru Base Walk' (14 ways, closed loop, 9.57 km mapped); point exactly half the loop length from the Mala-walk start, on the route.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.note: A closed loop has no unique midpoint: this is opposite the Mala car park (start), on the south-east side. OSM length is 9.6 km against the official 10.6 km.

dest:tennant-creek.note: About 110 m from the previous Wikipedia point; no spot pin within 150 m.

dest:kakadu-national-park.coordinates_source: Unchanged. On land in Jabiru, 50 m from OSM tourism=information node 3511903306 'Bowali Visitor's Centre' on the Kakadu Highway; Jabiru place=town node is 2 km east.
dest:kakadu-national-park.note: Verified on land near Bowali; 69 m from spot kakadu-national-park-8, so no clash. No change needed.
